adoption.semi_coarse: SP_LOW lower inferred height; SP_OTHER relative scale comparison parent
adoption.semi_fine: SP_L conditional height type; SP_A old-origin supported scale subtype; SP_T relative comparison group

adopted_semi_labels.fine_adoption_status: SP_A new-origin rows retain frozen labels but explicitly record failure of repeatable new-origin support
adopted_semi_labels.lobo_inventory: 62 workers in each of the 12 buildings with actual Semi observations; insufficient history is explicitly unassigned

frozen_structural_exploration.manual: still adopted and copied without relabeling into recommended files
frozen_structural_exploration.semi_old_origin: interpretable final structure with initialization evidence; exploratory auxiliary labels
frozen_structural_exploration.semi_new_origin: not supported as repeatable cross-building structure types
frozen_structural_exploration.fusion: original frozen labels preserved; failed candidates were not rewritten after outcomes

secondary_semi_labels.missing_worker_row: insufficient_target_building_excluded_history; do not fill from all-data labels

scope.training: ordinary non-OOS personal_comparison and peer_n>=3; each condition fitted separately
scope.support: at least12 comparable images in at least4 buildings
scope.doorway: separate external condition using ordinary-history labels excluding entire target building
scope.historical_exclusions: behavioural evidence only; labels do not restore formal vote or quality eligibility

metrics.turn_n: pair_n minus <=5deg near-straight nodes; descriptor, no point deletion
metrics.short_turn_edges: existing <4 percent perimeter and both endpoint turns>=15deg descriptor
metrics.log_area: natural log camera-height-normalized floor area; not automatically scope choice
metrics.log_height: natural log mean paired-ray total height with camera height1; not automatically top-boundary error
metrics.Q: existing qualified B8L2 and D10 only
metrics.T_primary: source_active_time_seconds, adjusted within task and origin; new origin reported processed time
metrics.T_target: target_matched_time_seconds retained separately, may be missing
metrics.summary_support: each metric's image_n/building_n/panel_n must be used, not generic panel total
metrics.same_count_height: SP_L minus SP_T, same pair count, bottom-ray angular assignment<=9/12deg, no geometry replacement

status_fields.fine_status: original Manual structural label agreement>=0.8 or member_sensitive, not prediction accuracy
status_fields.coarse_adoption_status: recommended conditional type or comparison parent, distinct from label assignment support
status_fields.fine_adoption_status: fine subtype's supported domain, e.g. old origin only for SP_A; unsupported rows are retained transparently
status_fields.target_condition_observed: prevents nonexistent condition-building folds inflating stability
